description: This file defines a PHP class 'File' within the Opencart\System\Library\Cache namespace, implementing file-based caching with methods to get, set, delete cache entries, and perform cleanup in destructor.

classes.name: File
classes.description: A class providing file-based caching functionalities including getting, setting, deleting cache entries, and automatic cleanup.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the cache with a default expiration time.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a cached value associated with the given key if it exists and is valid.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Stores a value in the cache with an optional expiration time.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Removes cache files associated with the given key.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Performs periodic cleanup of expired cache files when the object is destroyed, with a 1% chance each time.
